title: oreogrammitis plana
intro: Oreogrammitis plana, commonly known as the Pacific Hare's Foot Fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help alleviate various conditions such as arthritis, anxiety, and stress. The therapeutic actions of Oreogrammitis plana involve its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial activity, and display adaptogenic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
